newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini cancels India trip to follow Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini cancels India trip to follow Albania.

text.p: Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini has cancelled a trip to India so he can remain in Italy to follow the Albanian crisis, the Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday.
Italy has been active in seeking a peaceful end to the unrest and has bolstered its military presence in the Adriatic out of fear that all-out war could trigger an exodus of refugees.
It has evacuated 78 foreigners from the southern Albanian port of Vlore in the past week in three rescue missions using military helicopters.

Italy on Monday brokered a deal in which rebel leaders from Vlore agreed to end their uprising in return for swift implementation of a peace deal between President Sali Berisha and his political opponents.
On Sunday Albania asked Italy to underwrite the agreement aimed at securing a political solution to the conflict and to monitor its application.
Dini was to have left for the subcontinent later on Tuesday and return on Thursday.
